lines: 卡林邦城。
城南某处酒馆的地下区域。
这里是黑山羊赌场的秘密盘口。
昏黄的光从墙边的火盆中映照出来。
空气里混着汗馊味、脚臭味和各种古怪难闻的气息。
赌场大厅内摩肩接踵。
石砌的地面上充满着斑驳的黑色污垢。
吵闹声、拍桌声与掷骰的动静混杂在一起。
几个头戴山羊面具的壮汉守在各处，腰间都悬挂着明晃晃的短剑。
居中的那张赌桌此时正备受关注。
瘸着一条腿的侏儒老汉克整个人几乎都站在了桌面上。
他的神情显得很紧绷，明白自己遇到对手了！
那虬结的胡须上沾满酒垢。
旁边有两个佣兵打扮的家伙正小心翼翼的搀扶着他。
坐在侏儒对面的是一个面容十分英俊的年轻人。
身后还矗立着两个看上去一丝不苟的护卫。
虽然三人外边都穿着粗布罩衣，但举止投足间仍然展现出一股沉着的贵气。
他们正在玩最高点数。
两个骨骰就摆放在桌面上。
这是最简单直接的对决，无需道具，随时随地都可进行。
使用两枚骰子，由双方轮流投掷。
通过比较点数的总和进行胜负判定。
点数高者将赢得赌注。
若平局则重新投掷。
此外，还有额外的对子玩法
若掷出两个特定相同的点数，通常默认为“蛇眼”1+1或“盒子”5+5可触发直接胜利和双倍赌注。
双方桌上各自堆着不少正面印有葡萄图案的银币。
间或还有一些金币。
年轻人桌前的赌注要更为丰厚，显然在此前的博弈中占据优势。
而侏儒老汉克则是黑山羊赌场有名的“赌王”。
自从数月前来到卡林邦城后，就凭借不俗的运势和熟练的赌技杀得城内那些老赌客们溃不成军。
后来跟赌场达成协议，成为了赌桌上的头牌。
但今日，他显然遇到了对手。
眼前这个年轻人指名道姓的要向他发起挑战。
并选择了最简单粗暴的运气玩法。
开局1枚银葡萄，到现在已经赢走了他6枚金葡萄和143枚银葡萄！
“该死！”
老侏儒在又输了一把后，忍不住再次检查了骰子。
年轻人见状则嗤笑道。
content_en:
;;
Kalimbang City.
The underground area of ​​a tavern in the south of the city.
Here are the secret odds at Black Goat Casino.
The dim light reflected from the brazier on the wall.
The air was mixed with the smell of sweat, foot odor, and all kinds of weird and unpleasant smells.
The casino hall is crowded with people.
The stone floor was mottled with black dirt.
There was a mixture of noise, table slamming and dice rolling.
Several strong men wearing goat masks stood guard everywhere, with bright daggers hanging from their waists.
The gambling table in the center is attracting much attention at this time.
The dwarf old Hank, who was lame on one leg, almost stood on the table.
His expression looked very tense, and he knew that he had met his opponent!
The knotted beard was stained with tartar.
There were two guys dressed as mercenaries beside him who were carefully supporting him.
Sitting opposite the dwarf was a young man with a very handsome face.
Behind him stood two guards who looked meticulous.
Although the three of them were all wearing coarse cloth smocks, they still showed a calm nobility in their behavior.
They are playing for maximum points.
Two bone dice are placed on the table.
This is the simplest and most direct duel, no props required, and can be played anytime, anywhere.
Two dice are used and both sides take turns throwing them.
The winner is determined by comparing the total number of points.
The one with the highest points wins the bet.
If there is a tie, the throw is re-thrown.
In addition, there are additional pairs to play
If two specific numbers are rolled, usually the default is "Snake Eyes" 1+1 or "Box" 5+5 to trigger an immediate win and double the bet.
There were many silver coins with grape patterns printed on the front piled on the tables of both parties.
Occasionally there are some gold coins.
The stakes at the table for the young man were much richer, and he obviously had an advantage in the previous games.
The dwarf old Hank is the famous "Gambling King" of Black Goat Casino.
Since arriving in Kalimbang City a few months ago, he has relied on his good luck and skilled gambling skills to defeat the old gamblers in the city.
Later, he reached an agreement with the casino and became the top card on the gambling table.
But today, he clearly met his opponent.
The young man in front of him challenged him by name.
And chose the simplest and crudest way of playing luck.
He started with 1 silver grape, but now he has won 6 gold grapes and 143 silver grapes!
"Damn it!"
After losing another hand, the old dwarf couldn't help but check the dice again.
The young man sneered when he saw this.
